_comment: JAPAN / Japanese template. The answer is shown in ROMAJI (Latin alphabet, green — the phonetics) with the native Japanese (kana/kanji) on a smaller line BELOW it. Per item: prompt = English shown phrase, answer = romaji revealed in green, native = Japanese script shown beneath. The spoken voiceover reads the native Japanese. Asian-girl character, single Japan flag, voice kazuha (default Japanese female, native JA delivery). Use 9 items per video; keep each romaji answer to ONE line (≤~13 chars) so the two-line answer+native doesn't crowd the 9-row stack. Backgrounds: set a Japanese bg_query per video (no versatile-japanese fallback exists).
outro: Follow me to learn Japanese every day
